verses.1: And he took Salome to the child Mahaymanan, and he drew near to the priest Rat'e, who spoke to God and acted according to His law. And he was zealous, and he caused Satan to err, because he caused Simon to err to practice magic, from before whom was help for his brother Philip. And from before whom he showed by his hand, many believed who were called; and he became the cause of his error, because he mocked the priesthood and the gift of the Holy Spirit which he had heard from us in a vision. And he said to me: 'Our God, according to his prayer and bodily...' and he took you from us, and he became mercy for those who were led astray.
